42f1c3164ed7: Troubleshooting MultiDatePick: Fix Common Setup Problems
38b2ac9b8ba0: Every MultiDatePick setup message and access error, from a missing Save button to field security, each with the cause and a fix of three steps or fewer.
bae5060e0154: Why is there no Save button on my MultiDatePick calendar?
86a42dd448db: The component has no parent record to save the dates against. App, Home and Experience pages have no record of their own, so set Static Parent Record Id to the Id of the record the dates belong to, and check the object, date field and relationship field are filled in (or set Config Name). In a Flow no Save button is expected: the flow's Next button carries the dates.
7383c9e883cc: What does the amber Wrong component for this configuration banner mean?
557c62610c11: Config Name points at a config saved for a different component, for example a Booking config on the Date component. Point Config Name at a config made for this component, swap in the component the config was built for, or change the config's Component Type in the Setup Wizard.
f5c695f3fc9b: What does the amber Configuration mismatch banner mean?
e8cca656ea6c: The page's record, or the Static Parent Record Id, is a different object from the one the config's relationship field looks up to. Place the component on a record page of the object the banner names, set Static Parent Record Id to a record of that object, or use a config built for this page's object.
b1b20f2ba49a: Why does MultiDatePick say This component couldn't load its data?
ab4f98418509: A field or object name in the setup is wrong, or the user cannot read the object, its fields or the MultiDatePickController Apex class. The gray box under the message names the exact field, object or access that failed. Correct the API name from Object Manager, or assign the MultiDatePick - User permission set plus access to your own objects; on a public Experience site assign the MultiDatePick - Guest permission set to the guest user.
6e2e6e8b33e4: Why does the Booking component say Configuration Required?
73baa290e465: Booking needs a resource object, a booking object, a booking date field and a booking resource field, and the panel lists the ones that are missing. Set Config Name to a Booking config from the Setup Wizard, or fill in each property the panel lists.
69b461883653: Why does the Booking component say No resources available?
cc78f2a02907: The resource list came back empty, usually because the resource filter matches nothing, the resource object or name field is wrong, or there are no resource records yet. Check Resource Filter Field and Value against a real record, check Resource Object API Name and Resource Name Field, or create a resource record.
d21c8e679028: What does Capacity needs both time fields mean?
bfdb643f3f7a: Capacity Field is set but the booking start or end time field is empty, so capacity could not be enforced. The calendar stays hidden so no booking can skip the limit. Set both Booking Start Time Field and Booking End Time Field, or clear Capacity Field.
c41ef3a95972: Why do saved dates not show when I reopen the calendar?
5364a9704f25: Load Existing Dates is off, so the records saved but the calendar opens empty every time. Turn on Load Existing Dates and reload the page; saved dates appear, colored by status if a status field is set.
d3c64ffdc5b1: Why can't I pick another date?
41c665086e8d: The component has a date limit: Max Dates Allowed on Date and Date Time, or Max Dates Per Booking on Booking. Deselect a date to choose a different one, or raise the limit or set it to 0 for no limit.
dc85e2708cb0: Why does my Flow screen ignore my Setup Wizard settings?
f4d6977acb34: Config Name is empty or misspelled. A wrong name shows no error and the component falls back to its defaults. Set Config Name to the config's name exactly as the Setup Wizard saved it; every checkbox then comes from the config, so the on/off inputs can be left alone.
4965d8918f2f: Why can't Experience Cloud site members see records they created?
3fc45beae0d8: Experience Cloud sharing: site users only see records that sharing gives them. Add a sharing rule, or a sharing set for members, on the object the dates save to, or open its external org-wide default.
8d4e11faf957: Why will the record not open, or why do users get insufficient privileges?
898ed6c790d4: The user cannot read the parent object, or sharing hides that record. Assign MultiDatePick - User, give Read on the parent object in a permission set, and check that sharing gives the user that record.
e80adcb3468f: What does No read access to field X on object Y mean?
b6b3a5bdf7d8: The user has no Read field-level security on a field the calendar shows, such as a status, hover, date or time field. Grant Read on the field named in the message. Do it for admins too: a new custom field is hidden from everyone, System Administrators included, until a permission set grants it.
1af219fc27fd: Why does MultiDatePick say You need a MultiDatePick license to use this calendar?
104f1d23f510: MultiDatePick is licensed per seat and this user has not been assigned one. In Setup, open Installed Packages, click Manage Licenses next to MultiDatePick, then Add Users. Site guests never need a seat.
85e836341aff: Why are some days or times grayed out in MultiDatePick?
3ae5056847c3: A booking rule closes them: Minimum Notice (Hours) closes anything starting too soon, Book Up To (Days Ahead) closes days past the rolling window, and Earliest or Latest Selectable Date, blocked dates and each resource's business hours close the rest. Set notice and the window to 0 to turn them off.
d68a0eecd444: Why is the slot right after a booking taken?
1094a638ff06: Buffer Between Bookings (Minutes) keeps time free after every booking on the same resource for cleanup or turnaround. Lower it, or set it to 0 for back-to-back bookings.
0fe9b2bed8e7: Why is there no Add to Calendar button after saving?
4d7c025886f4: Show Add to Calendar After Saving is off by default. Turn it on in the component properties or the config; after a save, a bar under the toast offers one calendar file for Outlook, Google Calendar or Apple Calendar.
9bcf9ebcdad5: Why do I get Time group failed to save or Failed to create bookings?
42b15b196da2: The user can read the fields but cannot edit one the save writes, often a status, second picklist or time field added later. Grant Edit on every field the calendar writes (date, start and end time, status, second picklist, name field and the parent lookup) and Create on the object the records save to.
cbb1a9c2072f: The new record points at a record the user cannot see: the parent or the resource. Give at least Read on the parent and resource objects and sharing on those records. On a public site, book guests against a custom object, because Salesforce restricts guest access to Contacts and Accounts.
9dc16967c672: Why do guests see an empty calendar?
e56bf8694cb3: The guest sharing rule is not in effect yet, or the guest profile is missing a step. Set the object's external org-wide default to Private and click Recalculate in Setup, Sharing Settings. Assign the MultiDatePick - Guest permission set to the guest user, give it Read on each of your own objects and fields, and activate the site.
